description: This Java source file defines a final class PolicyEntryModificationInvalidException, which extends DittoRuntimeException and implements PolicyException. The class represents a specific exception thrown when modifications to a PolicyEntry would lead to an invalid Policy. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages, JSON objects, and setting headers. The class also contains a nested Builder class for creating instances with a fluent API.
